name: Preloop (Self-Hosted OSS)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted AI agent control plane with MCP firewall, model gateway, policy rules, human approvals, agent flows, private runners and runtime observability; no published software usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Self-hosted OSS does not include free compute, model API calls or managed cloud runners. Team RBAC, account-level role controls and some enterprise features require Cloud/Enterprise; self-hosted operators must secure credentials and infrastructure.
